title: Playboy Magazine July 1988 Cindy Crawford Herb Ritts Cover Jay Leno Jesse
conditionDescription: Cover shows light wear with a small scuff near the lower left. Centerfold not separately verified.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, July 1988 issue. Cover price $4.00.

Features:
- Supermodel Cindy Crawford by super photographer Herb Ritts - cover and pictorial (her first Playboy appearance)
- The Last Words on Ronald Reagan
- Plus Jay Leno, Jesse Jackson, Dan Greenburg, Paul Hogan, Judge Reinhold, Buster Poindexter

The back cover carries a 1988 Toyota 4x4 truck ad.

Condition: pre-owned with normal signs of age and storage. Cover shows light wear with a small scuff near the lower left. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
